# Panel

Side panel column with surface-tray sections.

`OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Panel`

## Use

```jsx
<OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Panel title="…">…</OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Panel>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="OmniOSDesignSystem_a7120f.Panel" title="…">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Side panel beside a thread (the Thread page's `.panel-in` column): white, 1px left line, 52px header in the display face, body of PanelSections — each a 20px-radius surface tray with a caption label. Slides in 18px and settles (500ms). Resizable: drag the left edge (a 2px line appears on hover), double-click to reset, ←/→ nudge 16px (⇧ 48px) when focused. Width persists to localStorage under `storageKey`.
